"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President George W. Bush, working with Congress, drew up plans to take the fight to the enemy and vowed to bring the terrorists to justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President George W. Bush and Congress took steps to help the wounded, honor the dead, and secure the homeland.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Thanks to President George W. Bush's leadership, the skill of the American military, and the commitment of allies, there are more than 50 million newly free people in Afghanistan and Iraq.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"America is safer thanks to President George W. Bush's leadership, the skill of the American military, and the commitment of allies.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
